evidence: Our venture capital business is focused on fund strategies that seek to advance proprietary artificial intelligence solutions and to partner with industry leading vendors to help drive efficiencies for our portfolio companies, assets and certain investment and business processes.

We are advancing our capabilities in these areas as their application to our industry continues to evolve, but if we are unable to adequately do so, or do so at a slower pace than others in our industry, we may be at a competitive disadvantage.
technological developments in artificial intelligence could disrupt the markets in which we operate and subject us to increased competition, legal and regulatory risks and compliance costs.

our competitors have instituted or may institute low cost high speed financial applications and services based on artificial intelligence and new competitors may enter the asset management space using new investment platforms based on artificial intelligence
ai_positioning.summary: ARES intègre l'IA dans ses opérations et ses stratégies d'investissement via son activité de venture capital, tout en reconnaissant les risques concurrentiels et réglementaires liés à l'IA. La société développe ses capacités IA en interne mais adopte une posture défensive face à la disruption technologique.
